name: Well integrity and CO2-resistant cements
principle: Portland cement degrades in CO2-rich brine by acid-driven decalcification, carbonation and leaching. Candidate systems include modified Portland, calcium aluminate (CAC), calcium aluminate phosphate (CAPC), magnesium phosphate (MPC) cements, geopolymers and resin sealants; a 2025 review found CAC, CAPC and MPC best at retaining strength and limiting carbonation depth.

process_steps.name: Select cement system with API-aligned laboratory protocol

advantages: Alternative binders outperform Portland in lab tests (review)
